core_meaning.primary_meaning: Sule is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Consolation”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Sule corresponds to the Arabic form سُولَى (Arabic root س ل و (s-l-w); سُلْوَى (Sulwā)). Its core sense is sule; consolation (turkish form). Sule is the Turkish form of Arabic سُلْوَى (Sulwā), meaning 'consolation'.
